svg.title: Tail validity and whole-block extension
svg.desc: At ten positions three blocks hold 1280 valid bytes and 256 slack. At twelve the same blocks are full. Thirteen positions needs four blocks and 384 slack. The pool backing stays 4096 bytes. Publication and completion govern visibility and release.
svg.text: A partial tail stays unreadable beyond the valid prefix
B = 4; k = 128 bytes/position; no old-KV relocation in this model
Valid: 1280 bytes; assigned: 1536 bytes; slack: 256 bytes
Last block: 2 valid rows / 2 reserved rows
Valid: 1536 bytes; assigned: 1536 bytes; slack: 0 bytes
Last block: 4 valid rows / 0 reserved rows
Valid: 1664 bytes; assigned: 2048 bytes; slack: 384 bytes
Last block: 1 valid row / 3 reserved rows
12 → 13 needs one free slot, new-row writes and table publication.
Failure before publication preserves N = 12 and its old prefix.
Cancellation closes new use; in-flight storage waits for safe completion.
The preallocated eight-slot backing payload remains 4,096 bytes.
